name: RCA CTDPFA salinity calibration, Cabled-09 RR1809-RR1812 (2018)

annotations.annotation: On Saturday, September 16, 2017 at around 12:15 GMT, the CA Shallow Profiler at Endurance (CE04OSPS) went offline due to an overcurrent power event. Initial investigation indicated external aggression on one of the two anchor legs, pulling the platform that is normally fixed at 200m below the surface to 400m, and then rose to 100m before communications were lost. No data products are expected from CE04OSPS until the platform is re-deployed. For more information, please contact help@oceanobservatories.org

rca:flags.text: Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (8259 scans, 8236 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.

Bottle salinity is taken from the cruise's discrete summary (the laboratory's Autosal and cast-log workbooks are not available for this cruise); replicates are averaged and the summary's flags are applied.
Niskin 9 (CTD-011 Niskin 9, ~142 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle -0.0031 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.001 PSU/m.
